directory_live_storage.scope: Requested live bytes for directory lists and handles only; excludes allocator overhead, realloc overlap, other caches and process memory.

registration.mechanism: Successful grafting releases displaced carrier-page references; restoring reloads the unchanged on-disk carrier. Requested metadata excludes allocation rounding, file/xarray structures, page tables and messages.

result.scope: Real SIF application with only owner+registration resident; then identical copied image after all task modules unload.

shared_application.scope: SIF application integration; no performance or PFN claim

copied_application.scope: SIF application integration; no performance or PFN claim

accounting_cases.assumption: Prepared core and registration support already resident
accounting_cases.interpretation: Avoided backing is shared across ordinary copied consumers as well; no process-count multiplier. Private objects and kernel allocations remain additional.

accounting_cases.assumption: Prepared native core resident, registration dedicated
accounting_cases.interpretation: Registration module exceeds avoided code/rodata backing even before per-registration metadata; core-backing accounting does not establish a net saving.

accounting_cases.assumption: Core and support deployed solely for user use
accounting_cases.interpretation: Observed user-only deployment omits the native consumer and construction observer; copied executes after all task modules unload.

limitations: Module residency omits dynamic allocations; process PSS and module bytes must not be added as a calibrated whole-machine total.
Library removal benefits copied and VKSO and is not a saving caused solely by physical sharing.
RSS/PSS/USS snapshots exclude host backing cache, FUSE kernel caches, tmpfs output and page tables. GNU time maxrss is not simultaneous process-tree PSS.

Deployment sums use stages within each campaign, exclude compilation and validation, and include the construction observer. Minimal-deployment commands have one observed workflow, not timing confidence intervals.
The retained temporary decoded-output buffer still costs 128 KiB; direct decoding removes a copy, not this allocation.
